dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward a pointed posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth and continuous lateral margins exhibiting no distinct asymmetrical deviations or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Homogeneous dark slate-grey pigmentation across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Presence of sparse, diffuse longitudinal light-grey striations and small localized white punctate spots.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-contrast transition between the primary dark pigmentation and lighter superficial markings.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Approximately 4-6 distinct, small, high-contrast white circular spots distributed across the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Discrete white punctate marks suggestive of healed epidermal lesions or focal depigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Faint, parallel longitudinal streaks spanning the central dorsal region.
